# Accessibility and Internationalization
Use semantic HTML, accessible names, visible focus, logical focus order, confirmation text, and live status where appropriate. Verify CSS logical properties and both RTL and LTR layouts. Update `app-i18n.js` for user-facing strings. Test narrow screens and reduced motion. Avoid changing translation keys or direction without acceptance criteria.
